trajectory_summary: This call moves steadily from a cautious, exploratory customer to a cooperative, self-inserting one who invites his wife onto the call unprompted and books a time. Joel runs the script cleanly and without scope creep, but leaves the bill-pain anchor and interest reason unused as emotional leverage, and the button-up is thin on verbal confirmation.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day and time were mutually agreed. The wife was identified as a co-owner and self-inserted into the call but was never explicitly confirmed as attending the appointment.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: Bill was captured multiple times ($400, $3-600 range, $620) but Joel only reacted with mild commentary ('that is quite the range there... pretty crazy') at 03:10-03:14 instead of flipping it into utility-alignment leverage.
